Simple annual pricing

Keep the listing inexpensive. Pay more only if the extras are useful.

Both plans are self-service and include access to the provider portal.

Basic
$12/year

A complete searchable profile with the information clients usually need first.

  • Provider name, credentials & practice
  • Headshot
  • Bio & contact links
  • Specialties & populations
  • Treatment modalities
  • Insurance / self-pay
  • In-person / telehealth
  • Availability
  • One primary office location
  • Self-service profile editing
  • Last-verified date

Prefer not to maintain your own profile?

Providers can optionally pay for managed updates. The standard plans remain self-service so annual prices can stay low.

How joining works

Designed to require very little administrator upkeep.

  1. 1
    Create accountEmail verification through Supabase Auth.
  2. 2
    Choose annual planPayment handoff to the existing Square integration.
  3. 3
    Build your profileProvider controls public information and uploads.
  4. 4
    Submit for initial reviewIdentity/credential details are checked before first publication.
  5. 5
    Maintain it yourselfUpdate availability, insurance, bio, media, and links whenever needed.
  6. 6
    Confirm periodicallyAutomatic reminders keep “last verified” dates fresh.
